title: Neon Rage: Streets of Synergy
genre: Synthwave / 16-Bit FM House / Chiptune Club Banger
hardware_target: Sega Mega Drive / Genesis (Yamaha YM2612 FM + Texas Instruments SN76489 PSG)
key: C Minor (with C Dorian house inflections)

channels.role: 909-Style Off-Beat Open Hat & Crisp 16th Closed Hat

song_structure.description: Four-on-the-floor 8-bit 909 kick, crisp PSG hi-hats, and syncopated Lately FM Bass riff in C minor.
Koshiro M1-style FM house chord stabs enter on off-beats with 16th-note SN76489 square wave arpeggios and snare roll.

song_structure.section: 3. Main Club Drop A - Koshiro Groove (Bars 9-16)
song_structure.description: Full club banger groove: heavy FM bass, house chord stabs, acid FM pluck, and driving percussion.

song_structure.section: 4. Anthem Lead Section B - Maximum Synergy (Bars 17-24)
song_structure.description: Soaring YM2612 FM Brass Lead melody over Cm7 - Bb6 - Abmaj9 - F9/G7 progression with double-speed chiptune arps.
Combined House Stabs + High Octave FM Lead climax, finishing with a classic Mega Drive pitch-drop and punchy stinger.
